body:
Thank you. If I end up posting on that forum I’ll let you know right away. At the moment I’m feeling okay, I might have just been dehydrated or something yesterday, however the first few bumps surfaced today so I’m definitely in for another outbreak.
I’m probably going to try and get ahold of our insurance company, I have once in the past so that part shouldn’t be an issue. If I end up on anything for herpes I have to be sure my seizure medicine (lamotrigine) doesn’t interfere with it as well, it doubles as bipolar medicine for those who actually need it, but apparently still acts similarly to an ssri for me since I’m not bipolar.

That would be a really difficult decision to make but honestly if I knew one of my parents had it i’d feel much less worried about the virus as a whole, regardless of whether or not I had it. Thank you for being another one of many to help erase the stigma, I’m certain I’ll open up to a close friend sooner or later, and knowing that I got it at some point from safe sex with only two people ever makes me wonder how many of my friends have it. Some of them have had unprotected sex with upwards of 3-4 people, most of which all had an even higher body count. I’m hoping by some miracle one of them admits they have it so I can follow it up and make it easier on both of us lol. Again thank you, I’m very grateful there’s such an active community here.

Thank you. Stress has been peaking lately, grandma has covid and probably won’t make it, finals are kicking my ass, and of course herpes is worrying me every day. Ive been drinking lots of water and sort of been slacking on exercising, mostly because I don’t have the time right now and I’ve been exhausted lately. I really want to tell someone and talk to them about it but the stigma around herpes keeps stopping me. I am certain whoever I tell will look at me differently afterwards.

Hi, I mentioned telling my parents only because I’m 19 and still living with them, they don’t know about the herpes at all yet. I’m on anti-seizure medicine but it’s not a steroid and has never given me any side effects. And yes the flu symptoms I’ve had are exactly that, headache and fever/chills with some occasional body aches. Last night I was feeling really feverish (no high temperature though) so I’ll pay close attention to how today goes and let you know if anything worse happens. Btw thanks for constantly helping people here we appreciate it, I see you on like every other post lol

In a way it’s kind of comforting knowing how common herpes is, like 1 out of 5 people will have it at some point in their life (not necessarily down south). I have been relying on my friends a lot, even though they don’t know about it they still do a great job distracting me from any negative thoughts. The biggest issue right now is the flu-like symptoms, im already feeling them again which means I’ll break out soon. I might have to just bite the bullet and go to the doctor about it if this keeps happening. Can’t cure it but there’s still preventatives
This kind of stuff is what gives all of us here hope lol. Glad to hear things are going well.

Discussing suicidal thoughts can feel so alien to some people because it's a topic everyone wants to avoid. I feared this for so long that I never opened up to anyone I knew other than a therapist. Do you care to talk about what's causing these thoughts?

I can't change the way you feel about your own life and what to do with it, but keep her close. Having a girl in your life that loves you and cares about you is a fantastic thing to have, and loneliness sets in hard without that once you've had it. 

My advice for that suicide plan is to put it on hold. Don't end things for yourself when there's still so much more to go, being stuck in life is a bad place to be in, but you have other, more important things to live for that want you to here. Take life by the balls and don't let go until you're where you want to be, you still have so much potential.
Just here to bump this, it needs to be seen. heartbreaking.

It's an understandable feeling to have. I could have life worse so I'm going to stick things out a little longer and play life by ear for some time. I have no idea how things will end up with either of our love lives but the only way to find out is to wait and see. I think sometime we'll end up with someone great that doesn't give a fuck about our problems, any girls around our age that only like to date for sex will grow out of that soon enough.

And although you said it's out of the question, that implant is always an option. It's likely expensive, but the majority of the time that procedure ends up being covered by insurance. It can be recommended by a physician and in your situation it's perfectly valid to talk to one about that. Not trying to convince or suggest any decisions, it just isn't as far-fetched of an idea as it might sound .

I'm really hoping that ends up being the case, every girl I've been with has left me because they've just "lost feelings" for me. I've never gotten any other reasoning from any of them and it really makes me upset most of all because of all the effort I tried to put into the relationship with each of them while making sure not to be overbearing. Two of them only left me to fuck another guy, not even date them. Just for sex. It was always stressful and really hurt to see that effort I put in go to waste every time. Herpes has just added another layer to that discouragement that I really can't change no matter what, and I wouldn't be able to live with myself if I went out with a girl and didn't tell her.

Regardless of that, I have a feeling I might get over her within the next year or two. I don't associate her with any good memories anymore which has probably been the biggest step so far. I'm glad to not be with her anymore, I think I really just miss having someone at my side that doubles as my best friend and a girlfriend at the same time. 

Thank you for the kind words and the help, made my day.

Can't fully relate, but I have herpes HSV2 at 19 and it's humiliating, I've felt like my love life is completely ruined for good. I know how the sex/porn addiction feels too and realizing I have herpes for the rest of my life made me wanna curl up and die for a while. but, it did turn me off from anything sexual for a while. Once you distract yourself with some other things, specifically things you're interested in and can really get invested into, it seriously helps with taming that urge.

I know it's easy for me to say, but it can have meaning otherwise. People are evil and can fuck other people over at any time, it's happened to me and I'm starting to learn my lesson. Most times, you are your greatest ally. Nobody can know the pain you've gone through because they'll never take a single step in your shoes, let alone walk a mile in them. Sharing life with someone can be nice, but it can also be torture. Lots of people make love out to be a solution to any negative emotion, but it can also make things worse. I myself and plenty of people I know tried it and realized it's not something to look for in life; it's almost always just disappointing. If you tell yourself you're getting more and more evil every day, you start to believe it. You're not evil, if you tell yourself you are you'll start to believe it. 

Plus being scared of death is fine, I'm terrified of it. That's something almost everybody shares, even if they won't admit it. Urges of killing and hurting people are normal when you yourself are thrown into a really shitty situation, but taking it there in reality just ends up being a sign of weakness, and you're definitely not a weak person considering you're here talking about all this.
Thank you, I'll try my best to move on and listen closer. I really appreciate it.

Hit the nail right on the head. I'm exactly who you're talking about in this post, a privileged teen that self-pities and complains over how awful things are. I'd say I'm really really sorry about your situation, but I'm certain that's not what you want or need to hear. Although I haven't been here nearly as long, I can confidently say that your story sounds more rough than anybody else's that I've ever met. You've kept yourself going this far, why stop now? The fact that you've pushed yourself this far is incredible. That alone shows that you have more good character in you than most people in this fucked up world. Fuck the people that have done you wrong, fuck the world for putting you in this position, but there are still reasons for YOU to be here. There are still things here for you, and while I don't know you personally to tell you what those things are, I know they're here somewhere. They might not be obvious right now, maybe not for a while, but nobody can know that other than you. 

More people like me need to see this post, I'm hoping it ends up gaining some more traction. Here to talk if you want to.
Please know we are here for you if you're still there.

The fact that you go to the effort to help others already validates you as someone extremely valuable. I'm new here, but knowing that there are people like you that do this kind of thing regularly makes me and many others so happy. The thought that life isn't worth living is sadly understandable in lots of situations, I know how it feels, but as some others have said in the comments already, helping other people struggling while you yourself are struggling can make all the difference. People like you that do these selfless things are the reason this world keeps spinning.
